Source confidence and imagery dates are unavailable; absolute imagery accuracy is unmeasured. Existing app accuracy-circle and edge-margin checks still apply.

Included roof and inner terrace remain inside the visible compound wall/curb, without observed crossing into the southwestern asphalt road or northeastern/southeastern orchard exterior. Accept only the exact source outline as partial mapped area.
findings.wholeBuildingUse: The included roofs and terrace form one enclosed mosque compound with a visible dome and minaret. No distinct non-mosque frontage or separate use is visible within the outline. Dedicated mosque use is a moderate-confidence inference from this layout, corroborated by the active worship node and absence of conflicting mapped premises/route uses in the pinned context; individual room occupancy was not surveyed.
findings.currentUse: The pinned original OSM node is an active Muslim place of worship without lifecycle or conflicting-use tags, and Google displays the matching mosque listing. No field visit or live occupancy verification is claimed.
findings.exclusions: The polygon excludes the public asphalt road to the southwest, the school across that road, and the surrounding orchard outside the compound. Pinned source context and full country geometry checks find no competing mapped use or eligible-mosque overlap in the included area.
findings.coverageLimitations: A substantial northwestern roof/minaret-side portion and perimeter/entrance portions are omitted. This acceptance does not establish complete building-and-dedicated-courtyard coverage. Source confidence and imagery dates are unavailable; screen calibration residual is 0.0528 projected metres and absolute imagery accuracy remains unmeasured. The app's existing accuracy-circle and edge-margin checks still apply.
